name: SENSOFAR - TECH
semiconductor_relevance: Medium -- the company provides high-accuracy optical profilers used in semiconductor manufacturing for surface metrology.
summary: Sensofar - Tech specializes in providing high-accuracy optical profilers and non-contact metrology solutions, which are crucial for surface metrology in semiconductor manufacturing. Their products are used in both R&D and in-line production processes, ensuring quality and precision in semiconductor fabrication.
